hints.title: Baseline Satisfaction and Opportunity Gain
hints.text: Customers arriving when the owner is not grumpy are satisfied unconditionally. The secret technique recovers customers who would otherwise be lost during a consecutive window of length minutes.

hints.title: Fixed Sliding Window of Unhappy Customers
hints.text: Slide a window of width minutes across the customers array. Only sum customers[i] where grumpy[i] is 1 to measure the additional customer gain from using the technique.

hints.title: Window Max Addition
hints.text: Calculate the maximum gained customers across all window positions of size minutes. Add this maximum gain to the baseline satisfaction to obtain the final answer.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of minutes (customers array length)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing window sums for every position from scratch takes O(N * minutes) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A sliding window of width minutes maintains running extra customer sum in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should separate baseline satisfied customers from the sliding window optimization.
complexity.notes: Window size is fixed at minutes.
